worldcombat.skill.tidyup.summary: The user sweeps a circle clear, removing every Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web and Toxic Spikes patch and any substitute around it - friend or foe - then briefly raises its Attack and Speed. With nothing to clean it still works as a plain set-up move. It only clears field hazards and substitutes; weather, another's existing stat changes and other lasting statuses are left alone.
worldcombat.skill.tidyup.use.0: Wipe a trap field clean after stepping into one
worldcombat.skill.tidyup.use.1: Sweep the foe's substitute away and force it to pay the health again
worldcombat.skill.tidyup.use.2: Top Attack and Speed up before the fight starts
worldcombat.skill.tidyup.description.0: A sweep of %3$s blocks clears every Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes patch and substitute in that ground, friend or foe alike; then its Attack rises by up to %1$s and Speed by up to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.tidyup.description.1: It then gains Tidied Kit for %1$s: the raised Attack and Speed stay up for that window and are taken back when it ends or is dispelled; while Tidied Kit holds, companions will not cast Tidy Up again.
worldcombat.skill.tidyup.wide.on: Wide sweep: the sweep radius is multiplied by 1.35, clearing more distant traps, at the cost of a 3-tick longer wind-up, 12 ticks more cooldown and the kit window multiplied by 0.9.
worldcombat.skill.tidyup.wide.off: In-place sweep: faster, with a longer window and a shorter cooldown, but it only reaches traps at your feet.
worldcombat.skill.tidyup.timing: A self move with %1$s block of range; after a %2$s wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s with a %5$s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.tidyup.growth.0: At level %1$s the kit window stretches to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.tidyup.growth.1: At level %1$s the kit window stretches further to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.tidyup.preference.wide: On: the sweep radius is multiplied by 1.35 to clear more distant traps, at the cost of a 3-tick longer wind-up, 12 ticks more cooldown and the kit window multiplied by 0.9. Off: in-place, faster with a longer window and a shorter cooldown, but it only reaches traps at your feet.
worldcombat.skill.tidyup.preference.ai.m: It auto-clears only when the enemy's traps and substitutes are worth more than the ones it would sweep away, so it never tears down only your own field to set up. With neither side's field present, a threat within this distance is the cue to use it as a plain set-up; larger tops Attack and Speed up earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight on instead of sweeping; larger gives up the set-up more often up close.
